source: read from the game over RCON on the seablock pack's game (tools/read_facts.py, Factorio 2.0.77, base + Space Age): prototypes.entity, .item, .fluid, .recipe, .virtual_signal, .quality; wire connectors and signals from entities created on a surface of the reader's own

notes.steam_per_s: a boiler: energy_w / ((target - water's default temperature) x steam's heat capacity); an engine or turbine: fluid_usage_per_tick x 60
notes.heat_w: a reactor's energy use, and a heat-fed boiler's (heat exchanger)
notes.signals: what a constant combinator takes and puts on its wire, by signal type
notes.never_transmit: taken by a constant combinator, never on its wire
notes.refused: how many prototypes of each type a combinator would not take
